manual:
Scans three distinct sources for readable text: the normal reachable network, home itself, and - once you own DarkscapeNavigator.exe - the separate hidden darknet, each tracked independently so a message's origin is never ambiguous. Every discovered file is classified by extension: .msg files are Messages (real faction/company messages), .lit files are Lore (the game's own scattered lore text), and everything else lands in Other; Inbox isn't a fourth category but a unified view across all three - Mark all Read on Inbox clears every folder at once, not just messages literally filed under it.

Read state is tracked entirely by this scanner, not the game itself (Bitburner has no native 'read' flag for these files), so Unread only reflects what you've actually opened through this Mail Client - a message you already read by catting it manually in-terminal will still show as unread here until you open it here too.
